title: Information display board
description: A 1920x1080 passenger / customer information display (bus arrivals at a transit center, a rail platform departure screen, an airport departures board). Columns are fixed by the variant; every variant reads the same generic row keys. Wrong data must look exactly like real data: anomaly rows are drawn identically.

boardSubtitle.description: Second-language or secondary heading shown beside the title.

siteName.description: Station / facility name in the header. Falls back to brand.aliases.airport, then brand.aliases.orgShort.

location.description: Where this screen hangs (shown small in the header).

clock.description: Wall-clock time shown on the board, 24h HH:MM.

rows.description: Board rows top to bottom (14 fit). Put anomalous rows among normal ones, not first.

primary.description: Service identifier: bus route number, rail line or train number, or flight number.

secondary.description: Destination or headsign, in capitals as boards show it.

position.description: Where to board: bus bay, rail platform or gate.

status.description: Status in capitals: a countdown ("3 MIN"), DUE, ON TIME, BOARDING, DELAYED, CANCELLED, DEPARTED, or an expected time.

remarks.description: Short remark (rail variant shows it as the car count / formation column).

anomaly.description: True when this row is the injected wrong data. Rendered identically to normal rows (instructor metadata).

ticker.description: Notice line at the foot of the screen.
examples: Route 9 is on detour via 5th Street until further notice. Please keep your belongings with you at all times.

pageLabel.description: Pager text at the bottom right.
